analysis.title: USA: GS Economic Indicators Update
key_insights: The nominal GS US Financial Conditions Index tightened by 0.1bp to 98.86 over the last week, mostly due to a lower 10-year Treasury yield offset by lower equity prices.
The real GS US FCI tightened by 0.4bp to 98.52.
GS Q3 GDP forecast stands at +3.3% quarter-over-quarter annualized.
The GS US MAP index of economic surprises declined on net to +0.1.
The GS October Current Activity Indicator stands at +3.5%, versus +3.4% in September.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Slightly tighter conditions: a lower 10-year Treasury yield was offset by lower equity prices.
Inflation-adjusted conditions tightened slightly more than the nominal index.
GS tracking estimate for advance Q3 GDP growth.
Economic data is coming in roughly in line with expectations, with the index declining on net.
The GS activity gauge, built from 37 weekly and monthly indicators, rose slightly from September.
